title: Nobel winner Mukwege warns of predatory US deal for DR Congo
summary: In tonight's edition, Congolese Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege slams the US-brokered peace deal in eastern DRC as predatory. Also, once dominant in Senegal’s economy, France is now being overtaken as China and Turkey emerge as the country’s leading investors. And we take a squint at the stellar career of South African sensation Tyla.
